clusters.name: Farmers market specialty food stall
clusters.description: Sell distinctive prepared snacks and drinks directly to farmers market visitors for a per-item price.

clusters.name: Roadside peach stands
clusters.description: Sell peaches directly to roadside customers through temporary produce stands.

clusters.name: Product vending machine route
clusters.description: Place and service vending machines at venues, selling snacks, drinks, meals, discs, or other packaged products to visitors for a retail margin.

clusters.name: Unattended neighborhood convenience store
clusters.description: Run a self-service neighborhood store selling basic goods to local residents through retail transactions.

clusters.name: Independent ATM placement route
clusters.description: Place ATMs at cash-heavy businesses and earn a share of withdrawal surcharges and interchange fees.

clusters.name: Ice and water vending kiosks
clusters.description: Install self-service kiosks that sell bagged ice or purified water to passing consumers for per-item or per-gallon fees.

clusters.name: Crypto ATM placement
clusters.description: Place crypto ATMs at convenience stores and earn a share of transaction spreads or host fees.

clusters.name: Self-service dog wash bay
clusters.description: Install coin- or card-operated wash bays for dog owners and earn per-wash fees, sometimes split with a host location.

clusters.name: Gold-melting vending machine
clusters.description: Operate machines that melt customers’ gold and pay the proceeds into their bank accounts; the revenue model is unspecified.

clusters.name: Vending machine retrofit and supply
clusters.description: Retrofit vending machines with card payments and sell or place the upgraded machines through college distribution channels.

clusters.name: Cologne spray vending machine
clusters.description: Sell quick cologne sprays from venue-based machines and earn additional affiliate commissions through QR links.

clusters.name: Coin-operated amusement route
clusters.description: Place rides, games, tables, or jukeboxes at partner venues and earn a share of per-play or song revenue.

clusters.name: Coin-counting kiosk
clusters.description: Place coin-counting kiosks with grocery chains or credit unions and earn consumer fees shared with the host.

clusters.name: Oxygen bar kiosk
clusters.description: Place oxygen-use stations in day spas and earn a share of customer usage fees.
